products.name: ColorBond Steel Fence
products.description: ColorBond steel fencing system with GO-Line, GO-Zag, and GO-Trim infill profiles, 1500/1800/2100mm finished heights, 2365/3125mm rail bays, channel posts, base-plate options, sleepers, post caps, and matching gate/extras catalogue data.

warnings: ColorBond steel fencing should not be used within 1km of the ocean or in salt/chlorine splash zones.
Night Sky / black is rails and posts only, not an infill sheet colour.
GO-Trim is catalogue-listed for 1800mm and 2100mm finished heights only.

rule_sets.name: ColorBond Fence Rules
rule_sets.description: Data-driven ColorBond steel fence BOM rules from GO ColorBond catalogue V2

rule_versions.notes: Initial ColorBond fence rules from GO_colorbond_V2B_lowres.pdf

product_constraints.name: finished_height_options
product_constraints.message: ColorBond finished height must be 1500mm, 1800mm, or 2100mm.

product_constraints.name: rail_width_options
product_constraints.message: ColorBond rail/bay width must be 2365mm or 3125mm.

product_constraints.name: profile_options
product_constraints.message: ColorBond profile must be GO-Line, GO-Zag, or GO-Trim.

product_validations.name: height_allowed
product_validations.message: ColorBond finished height must be 1500mm, 1800mm, or 2100mm.

product_validations.name: rail_width_allowed
product_validations.message: ColorBond rail/bay width must be 2365mm or 3125mm.

product_validations.name: gtrim_height_allowed
product_validations.message: GO-Trim ColorBond panels are only catalogue-listed for 1800mm and 2100mm finished heights.

product_rules.name: infill_height_mm
product_rules.notes: 1490/1790/2090 sheets achieve 1500/1800/2100mm finished height with top and bottom rail.

product_rules.name: infill_sheets_per_panel
product_rules.notes: Catalogue: 2365mm bay uses 3 overlapping sheets; 3125mm opening uses 4 sheets.

product_rules.name: channel_post_height_mm
product_rules.notes: Catalogue post guidance: 1800mm for 1500mm base-plate/rock-earth, 2400mm for 1500/1800mm inground, 3000mm for 2100mm.

product_rules.name: num_tek_screw_packs
product_rules.notes: Catalogue typical panel includes one 15-pack of Tek screws.

product_rules.name: num_support_posts_65
product_rules.notes: Optional 65x65mm steel support posts at start/end/corner conditions.

product_component_selectors.notes: No dedicated single-cap SKU in catalogue; Double/Full cap (CCAP*) is used for both cap options.
GZAG maps to Oxworks Sawtooth. infill_height_short only ever yields 17 (never 18) for GZAG, so only -17 exists at 1790.
GTRIM maps to Oxworks Trimline. infill_height_short yields 18 (never 17) for GTRIM at 1790.
GLINE maps to Oxworks Ezyline. infill_height_short yields 18 (never 17) for GLINE at 1790.
Oxworks rails are 2400/3180mm; short codes 23/31 map bay lengths 2365/3125 onto them.
Oxworks stocks its own ColourSmart cap; same SKU serves single and double cap options.
Oxworks stocks its own ColourSmart cap; same SKU serves single and double cap options.

product_warnings.message: ColorBond steel fencing should not be used within 1km of the ocean or within saltwater/chlorine splash zones.
Night Sky (NS) is available for rails, posts and caps only. Infill sheets come in the other 18 Colorbond fencing colours.
GO-Line ColorBond panels are catalogue-listed for Brisbane and Gold Coast depots.
GO-Zag ColorBond panels are catalogue-listed for Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Newcastle depots.
GO-Trim ColorBond panels are catalogue-listed for Newcastle depot only.
